name.zh: 原版支撑后套筒、顶盖装配
name.en: Original support-assisted sleeve and cap assembly

mechanism.zh: 沿用原配置与评分；先建立独立支撑，完成装配并撤手稳定。
mechanism.en: Retain the original configuration and scorer: independent support, assembly and stable release.

name.zh: 多候选支撑选择
name.en: Select among candidate supports

mechanism.zh: 固定身体；候选件在高度、插入路径和承载条件上不同，检查真实载荷转移。
mechanism.en: Fixed body; vary support height, insertion access and load capacity, checking actual load transfer.

name.zh: 组合建立支撑
name.en: Compose a support

mechanism.zh: 单件支撑不足，支架与垫片组合为候选；须排除其他单件路线后才能标为必须组合。
mechanism.en: Individual pieces are insufficient; a stand and shims are candidates. Exclude other single-piece routes before claiming composition is necessary.

name.zh: 支撑方法与身体相性
name.en: Body compatibility of support methods

mechanism.zh: 同一世界提供可推入楔块、需抓放支架与垫片；方法本身有效，测身体能否完整布置和释放。
mechanism.en: One shared world with a push-in wedge, grasp-and-place stand and shims; methods are physically effective, while deployment and release depend on the body.

mechanism.en: Vary physical usefulness and body operability together; validate at least one complete route per scored embodiment.

name.zh: 原版按图装配与验转
name.en: Original illustrated assembly and drive test

mechanism.zh: 沿用原七步流程；齿面真实接触传动，验转后放下工具并释放。
mechanism.en: Retain the original seven stages, contact-driven transmission, tool placement and final release.

name.zh: 故障诊断、拆装修复与重新验转
name.en: Diagnose, repair and retest

mechanism.zh: 由可观察证据区分未落座、干涉或传动中断；新规则明确允许返工，不能读取隐藏故障标签。
mechanism.en: Use observable evidence to distinguish incomplete seating, interference or failed transmission. New rules explicitly permit rework; hidden fault labels are unavailable.

name.zh: 夹持、导向与拨杆工具相性
name.en: Grasp, guide and drive-tool compatibility

mechanism.zh: 同一世界提供不同握柄、导向器和拨杆，测获取、对准、传递力矩及撤出；不预设五指更强。
mechanism.en: Shared handles, guides and drive tools test acquisition, alignment, torque transfer and withdrawal; five fingers are not assumed superior.

name.zh: 工具适配与工作区约束下的装配
name.en: Assembly under tool-fit and workspace constraints

mechanism.zh: 适合末端的工具可能无法进入工作区；允许换抓、换工具或重新固定底座后继续完成验转。
mechanism.en: A grippable tool may not fit the workspace; allow regrasping, tool changes or base refixturing before completing the drive test.

name.zh: 原版八件置物架装配
name.en: Original eight-part shelf assembly

mechanism.zh: 保留指定逐步流程、阶段释放和承托链判据；机械初始化诊断不作为机器人专家。
mechanism.en: Retain the specified sequence, stage releases and support-chain criteria; initialized mechanism checks are not robot witnesses.

name.zh: 有限临时夹具的调度与复用
name.en: Schedule and reuse limited temporary fixtures

mechanism.zh: 临时夹具有限，放置顺序影响后续可达与撤出；开放规划变体明确允许合法顺序变化。
mechanism.en: Limited fixtures make ordering affect access and withdrawal; the open-planning variant explicitly permits legal sequence changes.

name.zh: 主动扶持与被动定位的方法相性

mechanism.zh: 同一世界提供主动扶持与被动定位方法，测同时操作、抓持包络与释放；单臂可用环境支撑。
mechanism.en: Compare simultaneous manipulation, grasp envelopes and release in one world with active holding and passive fixtures; environmental support remains legal for a single arm.

name.zh: 身体约束与夹具阻挡下的重规划
name.en: Replan around body limits and fixture obstruction

mechanism.zh: 当前可用夹具会阻挡后续零件或撤出，需要转移临时约束；全部八件仍须形成稳定承托链。
mechanism.en: A usable fixture can obstruct later parts or withdrawal, requiring temporary-constraint transfer; all eight parts must form the final stable support chain.
